source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Whenever a model that has this ability makes any of these 3 moves, a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, the model can pass over models (except **TITANIC** models) and over terrain up to 4" tall. While doing so:

- it can pass within enemy models' [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), but must end the move clear of it
- it can also cross terrain taller than 4"; if it does, roll a D6 after the move, and on a 1 the model becomes **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**
